verifiedCheckpoint.name: ACTIVE-SPACE-CHECKLIST-REJECTED-RECOVERY-GREEN
verifiedCheckpoint.meaning: The behavior-traced active-Space checklist editor now preserves and recovers an exact terminally rejected checklist save as immutable read-only evidence across encrypted database, runtime, coordinator and editor restart. Independent review returned GO after correcting unsafe defaults and misleading retry/empty-state claims. Exact commit CI passed traceability, isolated local Supabase, the full 711-test target suite, and macOS/iOS builds. O-051 still blocks retry, do-not-retry acknowledgment and resolution; A-003/A-004 still gate hosted authenticated Sync.

activeWorkflow.outcome: Open one exact Project or Business Inventory Space browser, see its active Spaces in deterministic order with honest checklist progress and readiness, then select a represented stable Space ID and open only matching exact-scope detail.
nextActions: Commit the locally green, independently reviewed exact-scope Space browser implementation and push the Supabase implementation branch.
Run the immutable CI gate for that exact commit and require all traceability, local Supabase, target test and macOS/iOS build jobs to pass.
Record the exact commit and CI run while selecting the next catalog-backed workflow; do not create a promotion-only checkpoint.
Before adding another Sync-backed query family, extract and parity-test the repeated PowerSync retained-baseline, freshness-observation and drainage machinery.

progress.note: Workflow counts measure product progress. Checklist toggle is complete; exact read-only rejected-save recovery is exact-commit verified while the editor remains blocked only on O-051 resolution policy. The scoped Project/Inventory Space list-to-detail workflow is locally green and independently reviewed, with exact-commit CI now pending. The code-surface catalog is a passive completeness audit; the Product Behavior Catalog is the user-visible parity checklist.

blockers: A canonical production export or approved read-only access is required for production-profile and migration evidence.
Hosted Supabase and PowerSync resources, credentials, spending, and authenticated rehearsal require explicit user authorization.
O-026 must be approved before Project creation can be cutover-ready because its final project-budget command authorization, RLS, and Sync policy remain provisional.
O-051 must be approved before a rejected operation can be retried or acknowledged as resolved; read-only exact recovery may proceed without inventing that policy.
A-003 and A-004 remain proposed until the complete vertical-spike exit gate passes.
guardrails: Do not implement redesigned behavior in Firebase.
Do not access or mutate production systems or production data.
Do not create paid or hosted resources, migrate data, freeze Firebase, release, or cut over without explicit user approval.

resume.instruction: Continue the active workflow from nextActions. Load only its named authority sections and affected code until a concrete discrepancy requires broader history.
